name: A new Draenei Shaman knows the Warcraft Reborn Draenei racials (#8457)
contract: Report #8457: a Draenei Shaman (stock class 7) has no Gift of the Naaru and no Heroic Presence hit bonus.
SkillLineAbility puts no stock class bit on the skill 760 (Draenei - Racial) rows: 28875 and 59221 carry ClassMask 0xFFFFFA00, 28878 and 59542 carry 512 (Hero).

The stock-class Draenei racials are skill 11760 rows learned on skill learn: 1128875 (ClassMask 1535, classes 1-9 and 11), 1128878 (every class but Hero), and for the Shaman (ClassMask 64) 1159540 and Gift of the Naaru 1159547; 1159221 is the Warrior (ClassMask 1) variant.

SkillRaceClassInfo allows skill 11760 for race 1024 and every class, so a stock-class Draenei must receive it from playercreateinfo_skills like every other race's racial skill, and learn its own class's rows only.
Control: a Draenei Witch Doctor (class 13) keeps its custom-class Gift of the Naaru 814280.
This scenario needs a stock-class character because the defect is confined to stock classes; custom classes take their racials through AscensionRacialAbilities::CanLearn.
